diagnostics.title: Avoids enormous network payloads

passed.title: Legacy JavaScript
passed.description: Polyfills and transforms enable older browsers to use new JavaScript features. However, many aren't necessary for modern browsers. Consider modifying your JavaScript build process to not transpile [Baseline](https://web.dev/articles/baseline-and-polyfills) features, unless you know you must support

passed.title: Screenshot Thumbnails
passed.description: This is what the load of your site looked like.

passed.title: Buttons have an accessible name
passed.description: When a button doesn't have an accessible name, screen readers announce it as "button", making it unusable for users who rely on screen readers. [Learn how to make buttons more accessible](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.13/button-name).

passed.title: `<html>` element has a valid value for its `[lang]` attribute
passed.description: Specifying a valid [BCP 47 language](https://www.w3.org/International/questions/qa-choosing-language-tags#question) helps screen readers announce text properly. [Learn how to use the `lang` attribute](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.13/html-lang-valid).

passed.title: Skip links are focusable.
passed.description: Including a skip link can help users skip to the main content to save time. [Learn more about skip links](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.13/skip-link).

bestPractices.title: Serves images with low resolution
bestPractices.description: Image natural dimensions should be proportional to the display size and the pixel ratio to maximize image clarity. [Learn how to provide responsive images](https://web.dev/articles/serve-responsive-images).

bestPractices.title: Browser errors were logged to the console
bestPractices.description: Errors logged to the console indicate unresolved problems. They can come from network request failures and other browser concerns. [Learn more about this errors in console diagnostic audit](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/best-practices/errors-in-console/)
